stemMarkdown: In a 100 m race, A beats B by 10 m. Find the ratio of A's speed to B's speed, expressed as a decimal. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: When A finishes 100 m, B has run only $100 - 10 = 90$ m in the same time. Since the times are equal, the speeds are in the ratio of the distances: $\dfrac{100}{90} = 1.1111$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equal time is the hinge — it is what lets you compare distances directly as speeds.
